select * from client where 1 = 1 and client_status = 'TAKE_EFFECT' and id not in (select client_id from corp_commerce_info where risk_control_industry_classify = 'INTRA_GROUP_COLLABORATION') and id not in (select client_id from client_authority where user_id = #{userId} and level in (2,3) and deleted = 0)
and client_name like concat('%', #{clientName} , '%')
order by create_time desc
select count(1) from client where (client_status = 'TAKE_EFFECT' or (client_status = 'NEW' AND is_released = 1)) and client_type = 'CORPORATION'
select t1.* from client as t1 inner join corp_commerce_info as t2 on t1.id = t2.client_id where t2.is_related = 1
